aiResearchSummary.text: Cyberdontics is focused on advancing robotic restorative dentistry through various innovations. They have developed an automated dental drill with multiple degrees of freedom, enhancing precision in dental procedures. Their work includes methods for directing such drills using computer systems, ensuring practitioner control during tooth preparation. Additionally, they have created custom tooth clamps and methods for mapping 3D dental anatomy, which are integral for accurate dental cutting machine guidance. Their research also encompasses generating detailed 3D models from intra-oral scans and utilizing laser technology for painless dental analgesia. These developments aim to improve the accuracy and comfort of dental restorations like crowns and fillings.
